CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting

  August 10, 2021

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  •  Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Erin Ung

DISCUSSION AGENDA:

ITEM 1:
APPLICANT: 233 South Fremont Avenue

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1. The
building color palette shall be revised to include color blocking; and 2. The applicant shall work
with staff to establish the paint specifications.

The applicant was absent.

MOTION:
 •  Katie Chiu moved to continue the item..
 •  The second was by Nora Hernandez
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

ITEM 2:
APPLICANT: Pyrenees Drive (adjacent to 2916)

Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that MWELO
compliance landscape drawings be provided during building plan check.

The applicant: Kamen Lai was present for Item number 1 and the staff report was given.
There were no public comments and no comments submitted by email prior to the meeting

  1
 The applicant was present and the staff report was given.

Chiu stated that the design was generally good. For the retaining wall she questioned the finish. The
applicant stated that it was planned for smooth concrete block but that they are willing for either
split face of landscape on the smooth block. Chiu stated that she preferred split face. The applicant
stated that the smith block would be a softer effect. Chiu stated that if the landscape is not maintained
then split face would be a better aesthetic. Another alternative would be smooth stucco which is
acceptable. The applicant was amenable to that idea. Chiu stated the the color of the stucco would
match the building.

Tsai stated that he preferred stucco. The use of split face would introduce another color/material.
He also had a question in regard to the 1’ setback from the neighbors property. He was in support
of the general design.

Udani confirmed the concern is the setback of the retaining walls. Hernandez recognized the two
issues. Her opinion was that there should be a consistency of material and finish throughout the site.
The applicant stated that he was amenable to the stucco finish for all retaining walls.

The other question by Hernandez is whether the roof is to be used as a deck. The applicant stated
that there is no access to the garage roof due to the height limitation of the garage. But that a railing
could be provided to disallow people (and children) from accessing the garage and the associated
safety concern.

Udani concurred with the stucco finish for all retaining walls and led a lengthy discussion on the
need for the one foot setback of the retaining walls on both side yards. It was decided that due to
both building and planning concerns that the applicant should work with staff on the best resolve to
this issue.

MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1) that all
  retaining wall finishes be smooth stucco and consistent with the building color; 2) there shall
  be a rail condition adjacent to the garage roof; 3) The applicant shall work with staff to
  resolve the side retaining condition with respect to the one foot setback and; 4) MWELO
  compliance landscape drawings shall be provided during building plan check.
 •  The second was by Katie Chiu
 •  The motion carried by the following 4-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

  2
 ADJOURNMENT:
MOTION:
 •  Nora Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:15
 •  Seconded by Katie Chiu.
 •  The motion carried by the following 3-0 roll call vote:

Ayes: Ankit Udani, Katie Chiu, Nora Hernandez, Stanley Tsai
Absent: Jose Luis Espinoza

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of November, 2021.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
